outcome: feelings about first moments with the newborn
cohort: 291 primiparous women in Geneva, Switzerland and Clermont-Ferrand, France
finding: Women's subjective childbirth experience varied significantly by delivery method, with caesarean section deliveries associated with more negative experiences, particularly regarding first moments with the newborn and emotional status.
mod_finding: Delivery method influenced key factors of the childbirth experience, with emergency caesarean sections being linked to more negative feelings compared to other delivery methods.
